note: Fresno County park on the Kings River near Piedra, below Pine Flat Dam; the camp loops sit in oak woodland back from the river. Grant-funded renovations under way limit the campsites available (county page, read 2026-11-27): call before arriving. Swimming is not advised while the dam is releasing water. --Claude
summary: County page read in the browser (plain curl 403). $25 single site incl. 1st vehicle, $5 2nd vehicle, $9 seniors, free for veterans/active military; single sites first-come, group by phone; renovations limit sites. Site count and hookups cleared (directory-only). WATERFRONT riverfront -> recommend riverview (loops 180 m+ from the river, or behind the park road and a 35-50 m riparian woodland).
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend riverfront -> riverview; not --AWH): the Kings River here is ~55-70 m wide (a river, not a creek), but no camp loop reaches it over open ground. The main loops sit in oak woodland centred ~36.8205,-119.3588; their south edge (~36.8200) is ~180 m from the water across an open meadow. The small west loop (~36.8193,-119.3610) is cut off by the park's main road and then a 35-50 m band of dense riparian woodland. The stored pin (36.8190,-119.3583) is in that open meadow, which is crossed by dirt tracks but shows no pads, tables or spurs. The stored evidence ('spurs ... ~25-40 m from the water') matches no loop seen on the 2026 imagery. No county site map was found. Lead: if the meadow tracks are a sold camping area, a site map would be needed to raise the value back.
